_comment: Seed location dictionary for services/TransactionLedger.js resolveLocation(). Keyed off the decoded location-ID grammar (<body><class>_Outpost_<style>_<size>_<function>_<faction>_<instance>). Grow this by adding entries, not by guessing in code. 'confidence' is exact only when a bodyToken+function+faction combination pins exactly one named place; otherwise list every real candidate and mark it inferred so the UI never presents a guess as fact.

bodies._comment: bodyToken -> human display for the celestial body. bodyToken is the <system><planetRoman><moonLetter> prefix, e.g. Pyro5d = Pyro V, moon d.

outposts._comment: Worked example from the feature brief §9 / §4.1 — Fairo has exactly one depot, so function+faction+instance pins it uniquely.
outposts.name: FEO Canyon Depot

outposts._comment: Ignis has two outlaw trading posts of this shape; function+faction alone doesn't disambiguate. List both candidates rather than guessing.
